headline: As of 2026-10-24: 26,583,279 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 47 of 50 states, D+11.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 26,583,279 early/mail ballots cast so far across 47 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (3,791,626), California (2,758,100), Florida (2,576,035).
